name: Touchdown Girls
source:
Your future awaits at Brigham University, an institution of higher learning known mostly for it's raging parties and beautiful female students!

The story follows an up-and-coming college football player, Mike Mueller, eager to become the starting quarterback for the Brigham Hornets. Along the way, he will discover the ins and outs of Brigham University as well as earn the affection from the student body including 6 beautiful women.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2164760/Touchdown_Girls/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你的未來將在Brigham大學展開。這所高等學府最出名的就是狂歡派對和美麗的女學生！

故事圍繞一名冉冉升起的大學橄欖球運動員麥克．米勒展開。他渴望成為Brigham Hornets球隊的先發四分衛。一路上，他將逐漸瞭解Brigham大學的各個面向，並贏得學生們的青睞，其中包括6位美麗女孩。[引自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2164760/Touchdown_Girls/]Steam[/url]]
